FileWhat it is

Shop_Insights_Guide.pdfThis guide.

LICENSE.txtWhat you may and may not do with the file.

The HTML file isn’t a document that opens an app: it is the app. Everything is inside it, and your Etsy files are read on your own computer. Nothing is uploaded.

Setting up: about fifteen minutes

  1. Extract the ZIP into a folder you’ll find again. A synced folder (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive) is ideal.
  2. Double-click ShopInsights.html. It opens in Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox like a web page, and works offline from then on.
  3. Take the welcome tour. A few short slides: importing, take-home, profit and backups.
  4. Add your shop and import your Etsy files (pages 3 and 4).
  5. Download a backup from Settings & backup. Page 12 explains why.

Want to look around first?

Choose Explore sample data in the sidebar. Two made-up shops fill every screen, in a separate session. Return to my shops brings your own numbers back, untouched.

Your Etsy files

Download these from Etsy.

Shop Insights reads the files Etsy already gives you. Download them for each shop.

FileWhere to find it
Sold order itemsShop Manager → Settings → Options → Download Data → Order Items. One file for the whole year is fine. Start with this one.
Payment account statementsShop Manager → Finances → Monthly statements → Download CSV. One per month: the exact fees, ads and Etsy Plus.
ListingsShop Manager → Settings → Options → Download Data → Listings. Optional: photos, tags and listing health.
Etsy Payments depositsShop Manager → Settings → Options → Download Data. Optional: what reached your bank.
ReviewsYour Etsy account → Privacy settings → Download data (reviews.json). Optional.

More than one shop?

Etsy downloads the shop that is open in Shop Manager. Switch shops on Etsy first, download that shop’s files, then import them into the matching shop in Shop Insights.

Your buyers’ privacy

The sold order items file includes names and addresses. Shop Insights keeps only the country and a scrambled key to count repeat buyers. Names, emails and addresses are never stored.

The dashboard

What each shop really keeps.

The dashboard answers one question first: after Etsy, what did you take home this month?

Pick one shop or all of them at the top; every screen and printout follows it. The month strip under it moves through the year.

WordWhat it means
RevenueOrder payments, less the sales tax buyers paid and refunds.
Etsy costsFees, Etsy Ads, Offsite Ads and Etsy Plus, after credits.
Take-homeRevenue minus Etsy costs.
Net profitTake-home minus the costs you log yourself (materials, packaging, software).

Fees & ads

Every fee, accounted for.

Fees & ads shows your Etsy statement line by line: what Etsy kept and what reached your bank.

Switch it on first

Fees & ads, Insights, Year over year and Transactions start switched off to keep the sidebar short. Turn them on in Settings & backup → Simplify your sidebar.

Sales tax and VAT buyers pay

Etsy adds it to the buyer’s payment and pays it to the state. Shop Insights records it as a minus line under revenue, so it is never counted as your income or your cost.

What sells

Profit, product by product.

Products → Products & listings: what each product sold, what Etsy took, and what it left you.

Add what one item costs you

Type your cost per item in the products table, and its profit and margin update. Each product carries its share of Etsy’s fees, ads and Etsy Plus, at the rate you actually paid in that period. Download CSV keeps a copy for your records.

Pricing

Price for the profit you want.

Products → Pricing calculator: what one sale leaves you, and the price that keeps your margin.

  1. Start from one of your listings, or type a price.
  2. Add what you charge for shipping, any discount, your ad spend and your own costs.
  3. Set the margin you want to keep. It shows the lowest price that does.

Fees use your rates from Settings → Your Etsy fees, with presets by country. Tick Offsite Ads for an order that came through one.

Tax time

Set tax aside as you go.

Tax → Quarterly tax: a rule of thumb for what to put aside each quarter, and what you already have.

A summary your accountant can work from

Schedule C summary groups the year by Schedule C line. Export it, or the transactions behind it, as CSV.

Good to know

It is an organized record, not tax advice or a filed return. Set your rate with Change rate on the Tax screen, and check the figures with your accountant. Shop Insights is not affiliated with Etsy, Inc.

Read this one

Keeping your numbers safe.

Your data lives in your browser, on your device. There is no account and no server, and nobody else holds a copy, including us.

Please read

  • Everything is saved automatically in that browser’s storage, not in the HTML file.
  • Clearing your browser’s site data can delete it.
  • It doesn’t carry across browsers: shops imported in Chrome won’t appear in Safari.

Download backup, any browser

Settings & backup → Download backup: one file with everything. Restore backup brings it back on any computer.

Folder backup, Chrome or Edge

Choose a synced folder once and a dated backup is kept current after every change. The status shows the date and time of the last one.

When you need help

A few useful fixes.

What you seeWhat to do
It opens as code, not an appExtract the ZIP first, then right-click the file → Open with → your browser.
My numbers are goneUse the same browser and profile as before. Otherwise, Restore backup.
A month shows “estimated”Import that month’s payment account statement for the exact fees and ads.
A file went into the wrong shopImport files → Imported files → Move.
A listing shows as unsoldListings are matched by the start of their title; a renamed listing may not match.
Fees look a little offSettings → Your Etsy fees: pick your country’s preset or type your rates.
Folder backup unavailableUse Chrome or Edge on a computer, or Download backup instead.
I want the tour againSettings & backup → Welcome tour → Show tour.
